cohort: 430 women enrolled in a home-based maternal healthcare program in the rural Southwest Trifinio region of Guatemala
finding: The cesarean delivery rate among low-income women in rural Guatemala increased from 30% to 45% over a 3-year period, exceeding World Health Organization recommendations.
mod_finding: Younger age, nulliparity, prolonged/obstructed labor, and fetal malpresentation were significantly associated with cesarean delivery.
